text:
sam: Heads up — release blocked by a regen diff on the sample-app onboarding branch. types changed but it's just ordering noise.
ci-bot: buildkite: #4550 failed during `yarn regen` :x:
irene: Minimal diff:
```diff
- export interface OnboardReq { displayName: string; email: string }
+ export interface OnboardReq { email: string; displayName: string }
```
miguel: Yep. OpenAPI serializer isn't stable; typegen preserves property order unless `x-order` exists so output flips across runs.
toni: Changelog bot treated that as a feature -> minor bump and blocked publish. We need to ignore generated files for semver decisions.
sam: Short-term: add `src/generated/*.ts` to .semver-ignore and commit a stable regenerate with `yarn typegen --stable`. Also add `REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false` to CI to avoid interactive timeouts.
irene: I'll open the PR for both fixes. For long term we should make deterministic output the default in typegen (flip `--stable` to default).
ci-bot: sam pushed fix, rerunning build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #4550 rerun passed :white_check_mark:
miguel: Great. Follow-up actions: RFC for default deterministic typegen, update PR checklist to remind authors to run `yarn typegen --stable`, and change changelog bot to consult `.semver-ignore`.
toni: Adding short note to devex docs and the PR template now.
sam: Thanks all — will merge once release branch green. :rocket:
